name: Machinery vibration monitoring
principle: Vibration monitoring watches rotating machinery health with proximity probes (shaft displacement on fluid-film bearings), velocity and acceleration sensors (bearing housing), and keyphasor references for phase. Protection systems alarm and trip on vibration limits while continuous condition monitoring systems collect waveforms and spectra for diagnostics: orbit shapes, bearing defect frequencies, imbalance, misalignment, looseness. Trending turns failing components into planned work, and API 670 defines the standard hardware architecture for critical trains.

process_steps.name: Proximity, velocity and acceleration sensors measure machine motion
Monitoring system computes amplitudes, alarms and trips
Spectra, orbits and trends diagnosed for fault signatures
Findings route to planned maintenance or operational limits

suppliers.name: GE Vernova
suppliers.product: Bently Nevada machinery protection and condition monitoring

limitations: sensing points must be chosen from the machine's dynamics; retrofit monitors on wrong locations give false comfort
alarm limits need baselining per machine, not generic thresholds
advantages: converts incipient bearing and rotor faults into scheduled work
API 670 architecture is a mature, vendor-neutral standard for critical trains
